name: Cosmo Ferrites Limited
about: Cosmo Ferrites Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of soft ferrites cores in India. The company provides soft ferrites cores, including E, EFD, EP, EPC, ER, ETD, I, planar, PM, POT, Toroidal, PQ, PTS, RM, ROD, U, UR, EC, EI, EV, ET, and UT cores for lighting, electric vehicles, automotive, solar inverters, EMI/EMC, welding machines, customized applications, power conditioning, energy meter, medical, induction heating, railway, inductive proximity switches, and telecommunication applications. It also provides pre-calcined ferrite powder. The company exports its products to the United Kingdom, Europe, the United States of America, Latin America, New Zealand, Israel, Turkey, Thailand, Malaysia, China, Sri Lanka, and internationally. Cosmo Ferrites Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
